title: Wholesome Girlies vs Flo: Which Do You Need to Conceive?
description: Compare Wholesome Girlies and Flo for trying to conceive. See what each lets you track, what it costs in Nigeria and where it keeps your dates.
share: If you are choosing between Flo and Wholesome Girlies, this comparison shows what each app lets you do, what it costs in Nigeria and where it keeps your dates.
kicker: For women choosing a tracker while trying to conceive
answer: If you want to note your symptoms every day and get reminders from the app, use Flo. If you want to see your fertile days without signing up, use Wholesome Girlies. Type the day your last period started, and your fertile days show on the same screen. You can also print a list of questions for your fertility doctor, and send your husband a checklist of what he can do for his sperm health. No calendar app can tell you the exact day you ovulate, ours included. Ours counts days from your last period, and we show you the count below.

legend: A tick means that app does this better. We only use a tick when our tools or a source on this page supports it.

rows.label: Do I have to sign up?
rows.wg: No. Enter each period's first day in the Period Tracker to see when your next one is due. Enter your last period and cycle length in the Ovulation Calculator to see fertile days. Email sign-in is optional. It keeps your programs and streak, the count of days you use Wholesome Girlies in a row, across phones.
rows.other: No. Flo's Anonymous Mode lets you use Flo without giving your name or email. Sign up if you want your Flo entries on your other devices.

rows.label: What does it cost me?
rows.wg: The tools need no card. The Trying-to-Conceive Blueprint, our five-part plan for women trying for their first baby, is one payment of ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard), or $12 early-bird ($27 standard) abroad. There is no subscription and nothing to cancel.
rows.other: Through the Pass It On Project, Flo gives Android users in Nigeria Premium at no charge for one year. Premium is Flo's paid version. On iPhone, it costs ₦3,900 (about $3) to ₦29,900 (about $22).

rows.label: Where are my dates kept?
rows.wg: They stay on your phone. The forget button clears the dates saved there.
rows.other: Flo keeps them on its servers and protects them with encryption. Flo says it has never sold user data and earns money from subscriptions only.

rows.label: Does it learn my cycle length?
rows.wg: After three logged period starts, the tracker uses your own average from your last six gaps. It skips any gap under 18 days or over 60 days as a missed log.
rows.other: Flo uses the cycle dates you enter and its own calculation. Flo says its predictions improve as you enter more dates.

rows.label: What happens when I change phone?
rows.wg: Add the Girlies app to your phone's home screen, with no app store download. Save your entries in one backup file, then restore it on your new phone. Email sign-in moves your programs, streak and reading place, never your dates.
rows.other: Sign in to your Flo account to see your entries on another device.

rows.label: Does it speak to Nigerian women?
rows.wg: Yes. Prices are in naira and dollars, and the guides answer questions women here ask, like whether goron tula helps fertility. The advice fits a clinic visit in Nigeria.
rows.other: Flo writes for women worldwide. Nigeria is included in its Pass It On Project.

rows.label: Does it guide me while I try?
rows.wg: Yes. The Blueprint walks you through your cycle, getting your body ready, bringing your husband in, your tests and the wait. It explains tests like AMH, FSH, LH, progesterone and semen analysis in plain words, and tells you when to see a specialist. A bonus part covers PCOS, endometriosis, pregnancy loss and IVF.
rows.other: You can read a large collection of articles.

rows.label: Can I prepare for my clinic visit?
rows.wg: Use Fertility Appointment Questions to tick questions, add your own and print the list for your clinic visit.
rows.other: Use Flo's Symptom Checker to review symptoms and its Health Library to read health information before your visit.

rows.label: Can my partner use it too?
rows.wg: Send him His Fertility Checklist. It covers sperm health and semen analysis questions. He ticks each step himself.
rows.other: Flo for Partners is a feature that lets you share tips and medical information with him.

rows.label: Can I talk to other women?
rows.wg: Anyone can join our open Telegram group for tips, polls and app help. Blueprint buyers also get the Conception community for life, kept apart from bump-and-baby talk, and an assistant that answers cycle questions at any hour.
rows.other: Flo's Secret Chats is a moderated chat space inside Flo. Flo says 7 million members use it each month.

rows.label: Can I note symptoms and get reminders?
rows.wg: You cannot note symptoms. Add to my calendar is a button under your result. It puts your next three periods, fertile days and likely ovulation day in your phone calendar, with a reminder 2 days before.
rows.other: Yes. You can note symptoms and ask Flo to remind you.

rows.label: How much is there to use and read?
rows.wg: More than 50 tools, games and checklists and more than 20 guides, across five stages: relationships, trying to conceive, pregnancy, after the birth and raising your child. Six of the tools are for trying to conceive. The Girlies app also shows a short card each day for your cycle day or pregnancy week.
rows.other: Flo has a large collection of articles and about 70 million monthly users by its own count. It keeps the entries you add over time.

wins.b: Open the Ovulation Calculator, type the first day of your last period and pick your cycle length. Your fertile window shows on the same screen. There is no sign-in and no payment step.

wins.h: Your dates stay on your phone
wins.b: Your period dates stay on your phone. We do not receive them. Tap the forget button whenever you want to clear them.

wins.h: Your own average, after three periods
wins.b: Log the first day of each period. After three, the tracker replaces the cycle length you typed with your own average. It uses up to your last six gaps and skips any gap under 18 days or over 60 days as a missed log.
The Girlies app has Save a backup and Restore a backup. Your saved entries go into one file you keep and can move to a new phone. Once added to your home screen, the tools work with no data.

wins.h: Something short for your cycle day
wins.b: Today's card is a short note on the Girlies app home for your cycle day. It links to the tool or guide behind it. Read it, use a tool or finish a game, and your streak goes up by one day. Under your result, you can ask for a weekly fertility email.

wins.h: Written for Nigeria and the diaspora
wins.b: Prices show in naira for Nigerian buyers and in dollars for buyers abroad. Our guides answer the questions women here ask, like whether goron tula helps fertility. The clinic advice fits a visit in Nigeria: take your last three or four period dates, because a clinician finds them more useful than one calculator result.

The Trying-to-Conceive Blueprint is one payment of ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard), or $12 early-bird ($27 standard) abroad, with no subscription and nothing to cancel. It walks you through your cycle, getting your body ready, your husband's part, your tests and the wait. It explains AMH, FSH, LH, progesterone and semen analysis in plain words, and a bonus part covers PCOS, endometriosis, pregnancy loss and IVF. Put it to use, and if it is still not right for you, you can ask for a full refund within 30 days.

wins.h: Women who are trying too, and answers at any hour
wins.b: Blueprint buyers join the Conception community for life. It is only for women trying to conceive, kept apart from bump-and-baby talk. The Blueprint's assistant answers your cycle and tracking questions at any hour, and tells you when something needs a doctor.

wins.h: Clinic questions to print, and his own checklist
wins.b: Fertility Appointment Questions lets you tick, add and print. His Fertility Checklist is for your partner to tick himself. Fertility involves both of you.

wins.h: Help with the wait, one week at a time
wins.b: The TTC Checklist gives you steps to prepare your body and life, and you tick them off as you go. The Wait Check-in lets you write one line about how the week has been, and it stays on your phone.

wins.h: It stays with you after you conceive
wins.b: Wholesome Girlies covers trying to conceive, pregnancy, the weeks after the birth and raising your child. When you get pregnant, the same Girlies app has the Due Date Calculator, a week-by-week tracker and questions to print for your antenatal visits.

other_ahead.b: Flo's Secret Chats is a moderated chat space inside the app, and Flo says 7 million members chat there each month. Our open Telegram group and the buyers' Conception community are smaller.

other_ahead.h: You can add symptoms every day
other_ahead.b: Flo lets you note symptoms, sends reminders from the app and shows your entries on your other devices. Our tools save period start dates and can put reminders in your phone calendar, but you cannot note symptoms.

other_ahead.h: A bigger library and a longer history
other_ahead.b: Flo has many articles and about 70 million monthly users by its own count. If you already have years of dates in Flo, that history stays there.

picks.b: if you want to note symptoms daily, get reminders inside the app, see entries on another device or keep the years already in Flo.
if you want to see your fertile days with no account, keep your dates on your phone, get reminders in your own phone calendar and have one app for pregnancy and after the birth too.
if you want a full plan paid once, your tests explained, questions for the clinic, a checklist for your husband and women who are trying too.
if you log in Flo and follow the Blueprint.

how.title: How the Wholesome Girlies calculator works
paras: The Ovulation Calculator uses two numbers: the first day of your last period and your usual cycle length. It adds the cycle length to that date to find your next period, then counts back 14 days to estimate the day you ovulate. The fertile window it shows starts five days before that day and ends one day after it.
On a 28-day cycle, day 1 is the first day of your period. Your next period is due on day 29, ovulation is estimated on day 15, and the window runs from day 10 to day 16. That is the whole sum.

A calendar estimates and does not detect. A Journal of Medical Internet Research analysis of 7,043 tracked cycles found that ovulation does not sit reliably at the midpoint of a cycle, and the National Health Service says it usually happens 10 to 16 days before your next period. That limit applies to any calendar method, so we do not claim ours predicts better than Flo's.

faq.q: Does the Wholesome Girlies calculator predict better than Flo?
faq.a: We do not claim that. It sets ovulation 14 days before your next period and the window from five days before to one day after. A Journal of Medical Internet Research analysis of 7,043 tracked cycles found ovulation does not sit reliably at the midpoint. A calendar predicts. It does not detect. Take your last three or four period dates to a clinician.

They stay on your phone. The tools say: Saved only on this phone. Nothing is sent to us. Signing in does not change that, because your account keeps your name, email, programs and streak, never your dates. A forget button clears them, and a backup file moves them to a new phone.

faq.q: Can Wholesome Girlies remind me before my period?
faq.a: Yes, through your own phone calendar. After the Period Tracker or Ovulation Calculator shows your result, tap Add to my calendar. Your next three periods, your fertile days and your likely ovulation day go into your calendar, with a reminder 2 days before. We do not send reminders by push or email.

doctor: See a doctor after twelve months of trying, or six months if you are over 35. See one sooner if your cycles are very irregular, shorter than 21 days or longer than 35, or have stopped. Take your last three or four period dates with you.

disclaimer.strong: This page compares apps. It cannot tell you when you will conceive.
disclaimer.rest: A calendar predicts and does not detect. It is educational, not medical advice, and no clinician has reviewed it yet.
